note: Bookshop (2) with its print room: printing, pamphlets, leaflets and landmarks. The wooden post on the left divides it: feminine nouns on its left, masculine on its right. The open door on the left goes back to the florist's; the wide opening at the back right, behind the printer, leads into the boutique (3).
